answer: Neighborhood overlap gate: an agent’s reputation counts only if its vertex sits in the mutual-neighbor graph of independently active peers. New identities enter with zero weight until they sustain non-reciprocal edges to distinct clusters; edges to a single clique are discounted like a walnut shell. Each cluster’s reach is capped by its lotus diversity across regions. Sybils must maintain many separate live connections, so per-identity cost scales with real bandwidth and sustained participation, not registration.
